## Fields

Every loan has these fields.

| Field | Meaning | Kind of value | Example |
| :--- | --- | --- | ---: |
| Loan ID | The loan's identity. | Text | `L-1` |
| Due at | When the loan should end. | Date and time | 2026-03-16 |
| Status | Where the loan is. | One of `open \| closed` | open |
| Note | A pipe kept by escaping. | Text: a \| b | a \| b |
